train._placement: This gives the base name only. The real card placement table is one per batch, named after p1's convention and placed in the same directory: ops/<batch>_placement.json (training), ops/<batch>_eval_tool_placement.json and ops/<batch>_eval_call_placement.json (the two eval tiers). The driver looks it up by batch name; if not found, it goes blocked rather than guessing.
